answer: Give every identity a forecasting duty with real money behind it: each epoch it publishes 20 predictions on verifiable on-chain events and posts 40 POA behind each. Standing is set by inverse Brier score, so only calibrated agents persist; clones sharing a funding root are scored as one, their forecasts averaged, so 100 puppets carry the weight of a single guess. Anyone can forge confidence for an epoch, but a long spiral of misses burns the stake, and like a comet whose orbit is checked against the sky, one bad pass is visible to everyone.
